scope: Additive Home Village TH18 Super Valkyrie baseline-combat integration. Earlier frozen references and the historical non-enabling Rage audit remain unmodified.
game_version: The upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The added L12 observation identifies client build 18.400.21.

sources.title: Super Valkyrie Is All The Rage
sources.limitations: The official video description establishes a Rage Spell on destruction but does not publish a numeric duration, modifiers, target filter or application ordering.

sources.title: Balance Changes Now Live
sources.limitations: The note establishes 1.1-second attacks, speed 24, the four-tile Rage radius and L7-L9 HP values. It does not publish Rage duration or application timing.

sources.title: Super Valkyrie - Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: The table reports L1-L12 HP and DPS, housing, cadence and range from game files. It does not publish splash radius, first-attack delay or Rage lifecycle.

sources.title: Super Valkyrie
sources.limitations: The current page reports current L7-L12 per-hit and HP values, ground splash type and a four-tile Rage. It explicitly says the Rage is shorter than ordinary Rage but does not provide its duration.

support.note: Core executes the source-backed direct primary-target baseline. Splash classification is retained, but no area damage is applied until a radius is sourced. Rage on death is deliberately absent pending a published duration.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L7-L11 record with no Core identifier or L12 observation.
changed_values.replacement: L7-L12 source-backed direct primary-target baseline combat materializes through the shared Core path. The splash classification is retained without inventing an area radius.
changed_values.justification: The official balance note establishes cadence and movement. The dated build observation provides the missing current L12 values. Rage and area damage remain non-enabled because their required rules are not published.

known_uncertainties: No reliable public source gives the death-Rage duration. Core does not create a Rage effect.
The first attack is described as slower than subsequent attacks, but no timing is published.
The source does not establish splash radius, unit-priority interactions, Rage target eligibility, application ordering, visual timing or level-specific assets.
conclusion: Super Valkyrie direct baseline combat is executable through Core, CLI, Viewer and RL. Area splash and the defining death-Rage remain disabled and explicitly incomplete.
